subject.ref: Cycle 0 — 1stStep OS architecture and canonical contracts

criteria.description: Implementation architecture decided with recommended option, alternatives, tradeoffs, cost, lock-in, security, scaling and migration for every required area (runtime, database, authn, authz/multitenancy, storage, jobs, deployment, observability, testing, AI, research, media/model, connectors, capability registry, selection engine, compiler, export, future recovery, future continuous intelligence).

evidence.description: ADR-010 decisions D1-D19 each list all required attributes; open decisions OD-1..OD-10 carry owner, blocking milestone and default.

criteria.description: Credible plan for AI token/cost control and provider neutrality (Cycle 0 addendum and Universal LLM addendum requirements).

evidence.description: ADR-012 covers deterministic vs AI work, TaskSpec classification, provider-neutral ModelClient with Anthropic and OpenAI adapters, Claude Code/Codex adapters, context assembly, retrieval, indexing, compaction, caching, retry/fallback, structured-output validation, eval-driven routing, reservation budgets, telemetry, worst-case unit cost, and a COST_REVIEW mapping table.

Amendment A: policy before routing, endpoint-type adapters, BYO LLM with SSRF boundary, local/self-hosted boundaries, portable checkpoints, failover preserving run identity, eval registry; ProviderPolicy and LLMConnection schemas with rejecting mutations.

criteria.description: Credible plan for premium production UI/UX (design system, tokens, components, motion, accessibility, responsive, visual regression, states, performance budgets, review process).

evidence.description: ADR-013 sections 1-12 with CI-enforced budgets and DESIGN_REVIEW gate; consolidated gate criteria in DESIGN_REVIEW_GATE.md; locked brand mark per ADR-011.

criteria.description: Versioned machine-readable schemas for all required types compile, fixtures validate, and unknown/unverified is never confused with false/empty.

evidence.description: npm run check (2026-09-13): 'all schemas compile' PASS (20 schema files: 17 required types + common + 2 registries), 'every required schema exists and has a valid fixture' PASS (15 fixtures), 'negative mutations are rejected' PASS (48 mutations, including UNKNOWN-with-value, KNOWN-without-value, null and bare false/[] instead of assessments).

criteria.description: Capability registry and module registry define applicability, dependencies, conflicts, required files/agents/gates, adapters, phases; selection algorithm is deterministic and specified.

evidence.description: npm run check: capability registry matches taxonomy (301) and is consistent; module registry (22) valid and referentially consistent; every capability reachable through a module.
Selection semantics specified step by step with required golden tests.

criteria.description: Generation contract, research contract and external-action permission model are defined without contradictions.

evidence.description: GENERATION_CONTRACT.md defines determinism boundary, AI-allowed slots, schema-driven outputs, validation, errors, versioning, reproducibility and export integrity.
RESEARCH_POLICY.md research contract covers request, sourcing, storage, freshness, confidence, citation and canonicalization rule.
EXTERNAL_ACTIONS.md unified scopes and tiers; machine state test confirms permissions.json scopes equal schema enum and defaults agree.

criteria.description: MVP scope classified P0/P1/P2/LATER and milestones are independently verifiable with tests, cost, security and gates.

evidence.description: plan/SCOPE.md area table (generation vs execution) plus Universal LLM rows; plan/MVP_MILESTONES.md M0-M8 with all required fields.

criteria.description: No unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL finding or authority contradiction blocks scaffolding.

evidence.description: audit/findings.json: 26 findings; open items F-0019 (LOW), F-0020 (LOW), F-0023 (MEDIUM, version control), F-0025 (LOW) do not affect the scaffold; all HIGH findings (F-0001, F-0007, F-0016) remediated.

criteria.description: Cycle 0 performed no deployment, posting, submission, account creation, billing change, voice cloning or invented research.

evidence.description: Only outbound activity was npm registry package installation (ajv, ajv-formats); no web research; fixtures labelled as fixtures.

nonBlockingOpenItems: Owner decisions OD-1..OD-10 (ADR-010) and OD-11 (1stStep OS Audit integration scope and 'Project Genome' definition).
Product-owner ratification of ADR-010, ADR-012..ADR-020 and PRD additions.
Repository not under version control (F-0023) — recommended before M1.
FILE_INDEX.md and state mirrors regenerated at cycle close; full check re-run recorded in handoff.
